title: Unicycive turned away by FDA again over manufacturer’s plant shortfalls
llm_note: The FDA rejected a drug application due to manufacturing shortfalls at a third-party production facility.

title: FDA clears first flight of Precheck Rx manufacturing pilot
llm_note: The FDA launched a pilot program to facilitate construction of U.S. manufacturing sites and streamline plant assessments.

title: Unicycive gets second CRL for kidney drug as manufacturing woes continue
llm_note: The FDA issued a complete response letter due to persistent manufacturing issues at a contract manufacturing facility.

title: AGC Biologics Expands to Fill-Finish in U.S. Through Strategic Partnership with Pyramid Pharma Services
llm_note: AGC Biologics and Pyramid Pharma Services formed a partnership to provide U.S.-based fill-finish manufacturing services.

title: AGC Biologics 携手 Pyramid Pharma Services 建立战略合作伙伴关系，将业务扩展至美国灌装与封装领域
llm_note: AGC Biologics and Pyramid Pharma Services are partnering to expand fill-finish and device assembly capabilities in the U.S.

title: FDA selects Lilly, Regeneron, Fujifilm, 4 others for PreCheck Pilot Program
llm_note: The FDA selected seven pharmaceutical companies for a pilot program aimed at improving manufacturing and supply chain resilience.

title: Cytiva Completes Doubling of Utah Site’s Liquid Media Production Capacity
llm_note: Cytiva has doubled its liquid media production capacity at its Logan, Utah manufacturing facility.
